appstore.promotietekst: Chinese checkers and Halma on a 3D board in red lacquer and gold. Play online against players of your level, invite friends, or play the computer offline. Free, no ads.
appstore.beschrijving:
Leapstone is Chinese checkers and Halma for your phone: a calm 3D board in red lacquer and gold. Zoom in with two fingers, so every hole is easy to tap. Move a piece one step, or jump over other pieces as far as you can. The first player with all pieces on the other side wins. Play online against players of your level, with friends, at the table or against the computer. Free, no ads.

Ways to play
• On this phone: pass the phone around the table.
• Against the computer: easy, normal or hard. No internet needed.
• Play online: a quick game against another player of your level, 30 seconds per move. Some online opponents may be computer players.
• With friends: send your friends an invite link. They open it and join your game, in the app or in the browser.
• Puzzle of the day: a new puzzle every day, the same for everyone. Solve it in as few moves as you can and keep your streak going. No internet needed.

Two boards
• Star board (Chinese checkers) for 2, 3, 4 or 6 players.
• Square board (Halma) for 2 or 4 players.

Live online games
• The player who starts the game sets the time per move: 15 seconds, 30 seconds, 1 minute, 2 minutes or no limit.
• When the time runs out, the turn is skipped. Miss three turns in a row and you resign.
• Get a notification when it is your turn.
• In a quick game you talk with quick messages only. In a game with friends you can chat. Report a message or block a player when needed.
• Every player has a rating. See the ratings, and the games won and played, on the leaderboard.
• Follow your games in My games.

Like a real board
• A 3D board in red lacquer and gold: zoom in with two fingers and slide with one.
• No hints. Try a move as you would on a real board; a move that is not allowed rolls back.
• Player colours also differ in brightness, so colour-blind players can tell them apart.

Just a player name
• No email address and no password.
• Keep your recovery code to move your player name to a new phone.
• Delete your account in the app at any time.

Free, with no ads, no payments and no tracking.
